newsitem.title: USA: Mexico should address peso appreciation - economist.
newsitem.headline: Mexico should address peso appreciation - economist.

text.p: Mexico should address the current real appreciation of the peso before the financial markets become unnerved, a Mexican economist said Friday.

"You need a depreciation in exchange rate not so much because it would correct the trade balance but because of market perceptions," Jonathan Heath, an independent economist, said at a conference at the Americas Society in New York.
Heath, who noted that he did not believe the central bank was intervening in the currency market, said the problem with the peso involved market perceptions more than economic fundamentals.
